title: 看板按查找字段分道：第一页之后的分道只显示计数，没有办法加载它的卡片（接 #37327）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ② review finding S5(b) of the seat's L2 on PR #37511 (#37327), record 7188888406, note 7188910951; the seat asked the owning zone to card it under #37327. Source: reviewer.
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 (triage grades) · reach: a list view's kanban laned on a lookup with lanes whose records all sit past page one · evidence: os-dev report 7188670345 (out-of-scope notes), L2 record 7188888406.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：#37327 之后，记录都在第一页之后的分道会显示出来，并带整道计数，但没有办法加载这一道的卡片。
- 谁受益：看大看板的用户。
- 不做会怎样：用户看到「10 条未加载」，却点不开。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- ListView's rows-handed board has no per-lane paging, so a past-page lane (drawn by #37327 from the grouped read) shows a whole count with no cards and no way to load them.
- Add a per-lane "load cards" action (a lane-scoped read with the board's filter/search), or route it to the list filtered to that lane; pick one and say why.

## Acceptance

- A past-page lane offers a way to see its cards; a pin for it, with the board's filter/search scope kept.

Blocked-by: #37327
